note: Prefix caching is disabled deliberately. With it on, vLLM reported 74.5 ms for 8192 tokens on the L4, below the ~544 ms floor the card's peak throughput allows: it was timing cache hits, not prefills. Each timed run uses a fresh prompt passed as exact prompt_token_ids. Reported value is the median of 5 runs, and covers prefill plus one decoded token.
